verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own pages claim broad creator-app acceleration (video editing, 3D rendering, RTX Video Super Resolution/HDR, AI voice/video effects for streaming) which implies media-engine use, but the evidence never names the AV1/HEVC hardware encoder specs or any ISV/professional driver certification (e.g., Studio Driver, Quadro-style certification) that the story specifically asks about. missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encoder documentation, ISV/professional certification claims, independent corroboration of encoder performance.
